chosen_concept.prompt: A stylised upright clump of dune marram beach grass, Sleeping Bear dunes palette: tall slender blades in sage green fading to pale straw tips, slightly wind-bent, growing from a small mound of pale warm sand. Chunky stylised blade cards readable from distance, not photoreal. Real size about about 0.7 m tall, 0.6 m wide. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, one coherent family with Quaternius-style medieval/fantasy wood and stone assets: chunky readable shapes, warm weathered driftwood timber, sun-bleached rope, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood, maritime timber/stone/blue language and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures. This is pure natural vegetation only: NO driftwood, NO rope, NO cloth, NO painted wood, NO man-made objects of any kind; ignore the timber, rope, paint and sailcloth accent instructions, they apply to buildings and props only. Just the grass clump and its small sand mound.
